translate-all.settings.apiKey.name: OpenAI API Key
translate-all.settings.apiKey.hint: Your secret API key to access ChatGPT. Stored in this browser only, so it is never sent to your players. Each GM enters their own.
translate-all.settings.apiEndpoint.name: API Endpoint
translate-all.settings.apiEndpoint.hint: The endpoint to use for the API. Change this if you are using a proxy or a different compatible API.
translate-all.settings.language.name: Language
translate-all.settings.language.hint: The language to translate descriptions into.
translate-all.settings.outputMode.name: Output Mode
translate-all.settings.outputMode.hint: What to do with the translation: replace the original text, create a translated copy of the document or page, or append/prepend the translation to the original text separated by a horizontal rule.
translate-all.settings.minimumRole.name: Minimum Role to Translate
translate-all.settings.minimumRole.hint: Lowest user role allowed to use the Translate button. Translating spends the configured API key, so this defaults to Gamemaster. Users below this role do not see the button.
translate-all.settings.game.system.name: Game System
translate-all.settings.game.system.hint: Choose the game system for which you want to translate descriptions.
translate-all.settings.model.name: Target Model
translate-all.settings.model.hint: The model each translation request is sent to. Pick one of the suggestions loaded from the API Endpoint, or type any model name your endpoint accepts.
translate-all.settings.model.refresh: Reload the model list from the API endpoint using the key and endpoint currently entered above.
translate-all.settings.customPrompt.name: Custom Prompt
translate-all.settings.customPrompt.hint: Custom translation prompt written directly here. If not empty, it takes precedence over the Prompt Template File. The item description is appended after a colon (': <description>'). Leave both empty to use the default prompt.
translate-all.settings.promptTemplatePat: Path to a text file containing a custom prompt (e.g., /modules/translate-all/prompts/dnd5e.txt)
translate-all.settings.cache.enabled.hin: Reuses a previous translation when the same text is translated again with the same prompt, model and endpoint, so the same text is never billed twice. Stored in this browser only, up to 300 entries; not shared with other users or other browsers. Uncheck to always call the API.
translate-all.settings.cache.clear.label: Clear Translation Cache
translate-all.settings.cache.clear.hint: Discard every cached translation stored in this browser.
translate-all.settings.tts.enabled.name: Enable Read-Aloud TTS (experimental, PF2E only)
translate-all.settings.tts.enabled.hint:
Adds a small Text-to-Speech button next to each

paragraph in Pathfinder 2e sheets and journals.
translate-all.settings.tts.apiEndpoint.h: OpenAI-compatible TTS endpoint base URL. The module appends '/audio/speech'. Leave empty to reuse the translation API endpoint.
translate-all.settings.tts.apiKey.name: TTS API Key
translate-all.settings.tts.apiKey.hint: API key used to authenticate against the TTS endpoint. Leave empty to reuse the translation API key. Stored in this browser only, like the translation key.
translate-all.settings.tts.model.name: TTS Model
translate-all.settings.tts.voice.name: TTS Voice
translate-all.settings.tts.voice.hint: Voice preset used by the TTS model.
Free-form style/tone instructions sent to the TTS model (e.g., 'narrate dramatically, slow pacing, ominous tone'). Only used by steerable models such as gpt-4o-mini-tts; ignored by tts-1/tts-1-hd. Leave empty to disable.
translate-all.settings.tts.folderPath.hi: Path inside the Foundry Data folder where generated audio files are saved (e.g., translateAll/textToSpeech). Files are named by a hash of text+voice+model+instructions so identical passages reuse the same audio.
translate-all.button.translate.label: Translate
translate-all.button.translate.tooltip: Translate this description with the configured language and model.
